## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# Cluster analysis

setwd("C:/Users/micha/Desktop/PEACE_Data_and_Code/ROI_Data/")

forest_df <- read.xlsx("Cluster_Metaanalysis.xlsx")

forest_df$se <- (forest_df$CI_high - forest_df$CI_low) / (2 * 1.96)

# Combine cluster and weighting for the y-axis label
forest_df <- forest_df %>%
  mutate(Label = paste0(Cluster, " – ", Weighting)) %>%
  mutate(Label = factor(Label, levels = rev(Label))) # Reverse order for plotting

# Plot
foplot_1 <- ggplot(forest_df, aes(x = d, y = Label, color = Weighting)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    x = "Cohen's d (Effect Size)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Cluster-Based Effect Sizes: H3R Weighted vs Non-weighted",
    color = "Weighting"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```
